title: Robe Hook 2-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Unlacquered Brass | Malibu | Allied Brass
description:
Keep robes and towels off the floor and within easy reach with a compact, sturdy wall-mounted robe hook designed for everyday bathroom use in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story.

Highlights:
- Unlacquered Brass develops a unique, one-of-a-kind patina over time
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Coordinate your bathroom look with the Malibu robe hooks collection and transitional bathroom hardware styling
- Finish your space with versatile bath accessories available in multiple designer finish options
- Install with confidence using color-coordinated mounting hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 2 in. x 2 in. x 2.64 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 4 in. x 6 in. x 10 in.
- Shipping weight: 1 lb.
- Wall-mounted installation
- Assembled in the USA
- Limited Lifetime Warranty
